name: Belitong Geopark Run 2027
short_description: The Belitong Geopark Run 2027 is a half-marathon (with 5km and 10km options) held on Pulau Belitung, Indonesia on April 18, 2027.
ai_summary: The Belitong Geopark Run 2027 is a half-marathon event scheduled for April 18, 2027, on Pulau Belitung (Belitong) in Kepulauan Bangka Belitung, Indonesia. Organized by the Geopark Run Series, the race offers three distance options: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km, with the 21.1km half-marathon serving as the primary distance. The exact venue is still to be announced, and registration has not yet opened.
